news.headline: CEPB FY26 loss shrinks 83%
news.summary: Century Paper & Board Mills Limited (PSX: CEPB) reported FY2026 results with net losses narrowing 83% to Rs58.29m, per Mettis Global. No revenue, EPS, or dividend figure disclosed in the source reviewed. Company remains loss-making (small, listed-tier constituent, weight 0.06%); logged as impact 3 (notable, results date) - not a material earnings surprise given the company remains in a loss position and its small size.

news.headline: Auto sector urged to lead Pakistan's $63bn export ambitions
news.summary: Published Aug 13, 2026 11:13am PKT: Federal Minister for Planning Ahsan Iqbal, Federal Minister for Energy Sardar Awais Ahmad Khan Leghari, and SAPM on Industries Haroon Akhtar Khan called on the auto sector to shift toward export-led growth to help meet Pakistan's $63bn export target (part of a broader $100bn national export goal) under the URAAN Pakistan initiative; called for Auto Policy 2.0 implementation, five-year export plans and industrial-cluster modernisation. No new concrete measures, subsidies, or company-level figures announced - a policy exhortation/speech, not a binding action. Logged as impact 2 (minor, sector-wide policy commentary) tagged to auto-sector constituents.

news.headline: Oil climbs on fresh vessel attacks, Oman spill
news.summary: Published Aug 13, 2026 10:15am PKT per Mettis Global: Brent crude (Oct delivery) rose 1.01% to $88.09/bbl and WTI (Sept delivery) rose 1.15% to $82.31/bbl on Thursday, per CNBC coverage, following fatal attacks on vessels in the Red Sea/Bab el-Mandeb Strait and the Gulf of Oman, plus a spreading oil spill (approx. 400 sq km) off Oman's coast from a sanctioned tanker that ran aground June 30 carrying an estimated 800,000 barrels of Russian crude. Sub-2% single-session commodity move, continuation of the ongoing Hormuz/Gulf-tension narrative already logged repeatedly this newslog; logged as impact 3 (notable, oil-price-relevant geopolitical development) tagged to E&P and OMC/refiner constituents.

news.summary: Per Business Recorder ('MSCI adds 1 Pakistani co to Frontier Market Small Cap Index') and Bloom Pakistan, citing a JS Global note published Aug 13, 2026 around 11:42am PKT: MSCI's August 2026 index review added Air Link Communications (PSX: AIRLINK) to the MSCI Frontier Market Small Cap Index and removed Biafo Industries (not a desk-universe ticker), bringing Pakistan's total constituent count in that index to 80 stocks; no change reported to the main MSCI Frontier Markets Index for Pakistan.
